# DELETE /api/v1/user/avatar

Deletes the current user's custom avatar

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-129`

## Request

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **500** — Internal error during avatar deletion

| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | user_service.DeleteAvatar | service | Gets avatar path from user; Starts DB transaction; Sets UseCustomAvatar=false and Avatar=''; Updates user in DB; Deletes avatar file from storage if existed |
| 3 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | storage.Avatars.Delete | utility ⚡ | Deletes avatar file from configured storage backend |
